market_question: Will the US acquire part of Greenland in 2026?
reasoning: The US acquiring part of Greenland by end-2026 would require a rapid territorial transfer or exclusive jurisdiction deal. Denmark and Greenland have firmly rejected sale notions, no formal negotiations exist, and use of force is implausible. The market's 13.5% is too high relative to a realistic ~5% probability.
evidence_points: Danish PM Mette Frederiksen called Trump's 2019 interest 'absurd' and Greenland's foreign minister said 'we are open for business, but not for sale' in 2025
No public negotiation framework or binding instrument exists; any agreement would need Danish parliament and Greenlandic Landsting approval
The short timeline (less than 2 years) makes a full sovereignty transfer or exclusive jurisdiction deal politically infeasible
sources_consulted: Reuters, BBC, and AP coverage of Trump's Greenland interest (2019, 2025)
Greenlandic and Danish official statements on sovereignty
Historical precedents of US territorial acquisitions
